reasoning: The evidence shows mixed signals. Climate TRACE data (snippet 1) indicates cumulative 2025 emissions through November were 0.50% higher than 2024. However, China—the world's largest emitter—saw emissions decline by approximately 0.3% in 2025 (snippets 4, 6). The Nature Reviews article (snippet 7) suggests possible stagnation in power sector emissions but notes overall fossil fuel emissions continue rising at ~1% annually. Given China's decline but global cumulative increases through November, and that China represents only ~30% of global emissions, a global decrease seems unlikely but not impossible.
